report_name: Email Service Breach Leaks 77 Million Addresses, Sparks Phishing Wave

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: Attackers gained unauthorized access to the Arara Message service's database and exfiltrated a list of approximately 77 million email addresses and associated corporate client information.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Following a data breach, attackers launched a massive phishing campaign, sending over 7.13 million emails to the leaked addresses. The emails impersonated a credit card company to trick recipients.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: Attackers compromised a third-party email distribution service, Arara Message, to access data belonging to its 380 corporate clients, thereby exploiting the trusted relationship between the service provider and its customers.

campaigns.name: Arara Message Breach and Phishing Campaign
campaigns.description: A supply chain attack in October 2026 where the Arara Message email service was breached, leading to the exfiltration of 77 million email addresses, followed by a large-scale phishing campaign leveraging the stolen data.

identities.name: Paycloud Holdings
identities.description: The Japanese parent company of the Arara Message email distribution service, which disclosed the data breach.

identities.name: Arara Message
identities.description: An email distribution service in Japan, owned by Paycloud Holdings, that was the primary victim of a data breach, resulting in the exposure of 77 million email addresses.

identities.name: Suntory Holdings
identities.description: A company that reported a separate data breach affecting 90,000 individuals due to unauthorized access to an external cloud service on the same day as the Arara Message disclosure.

identities.name: Arara Message Corporate Clients
identities.description: A class representing the 380 corporate clients of Arara Message whose information was compromised and whose customers were subsequently targeted in a phishing campaign.

identities.name: Arara Message Email Recipients
identities.description: A class representing the approximately 77 million individuals whose email addresses were exfiltrated from the Arara Message service and targeted in a follow-on phishing campaign.

identities.name: Unnamed Credit Card Company
identities.description: A credit card company that was impersonated by attackers in a large-scale phishing campaign that targeted 7.13 million leaked email addresses.
